BREAKING: The average interest rate on a 30Y mortgage in the US rises to 7.24%, the highest level in 19 months.

This officially pushes the payment on a $500,000 mortgage above $3,400/month.

By comparison, the same mortgage came with a payment of $2,995/month just 7 months ago.
